Build & install the APK

Full native source lives in DesiMeals/ (Kotlin + Compose + Room). It compiled with gradle assembleDebug.

cd DesiMeals && gradle assembleDebugdebug APK
app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk17 MB, installs via adb
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apkinstall on device

Android Studio: open DesiMeals/ → let Gradle sync (AGP 8.5.2, Kotlin 2.0.20, compileSdk 34) → Build → Build APK(s).

Desi Meals web preview • static build in dist/ • native app source in DesiMeals/
